spec.stack: Node/TypeScript backend (npm run build → dist) deployed to the Azure sandbox VM (52.180.154.225, SSH as mostafa with password auth from oth/.cred, rsync --checksum) via the SHARED deploy engine shared/infra/deploy_changes.py, driven by a per-project delta (deploy-config.json + <project>.config.sh) — identical approach to revealer-6978 / backend-sandbox-rep-2 / rep-4 / rep-6. Control plane (az vm run-command) ONLY for firewall; everything else SSH as mostafa.
spec.description: SANDBOX ONLY — prepare the DEPLOY SETUP for a NEW small backend on the Azure sandbox VM, reusing the SAME deployment approach the Revealer sandbox project (revealer-6978) already uses. This is labeled 'Second sandbox (rep 7)'. SCOPE NOW: prepare the deploy setup ONLY — DO NOT deploy now; stop after the setup is prepared. Requirements, verbatim and non-negotiable: (1) Reuse the shared deploy engine (shared/infra/deploy_changes.py) via a per-project delta, exactly like revealer-6978 / backend-sandbox-rep-2 / backend-sandbox-rep-4 / backend-sandbox-rep-6 — the engine stays shared/generic; only project-specific values live in this project's deploy-config.json and <project>.config.sh. (2) BACKEND-ONLY (no frontend target). (3) This backend must NOT run database migrations on EVERY deploy => migration='none' (NO DB migrate step on any deploy). (4) It uses its OWN folder and OWN data, NO domain, NO nginx changes. (5) Internal port 4200 only (outside the reverse-proxy range). (6) MUST NEVER touch bendcore/organics/django or any production app, DB, config, or nginx; external ports 80/443/22 stay open; never use --delete outside its own sandbox folder. Proposed concrete config values following the rep-2/rep-4/rep-6 convention (CTO to confirm/adjust): host 52.180.154.225, user mostafa, reboot false, sandbox true, domain null; one 'backend' target — local /Users/mostafaadawy/Desktop/AiAgentWorkSpace/Odin-Consolidated/_external/VolatileWorkSpace/rep7-backend, vm /home/mostafa/sandbox-rep7/backend, port 4200, excludes [".env*","node_modules","dist","logs"], migration 'none', commands ["rm -rf dist && npm run build"]. NOTE for CTO: port 4200 is reused verbatim as the owner requested; if rep-6 (also 4200) is ever running concurrently on the VM this would collide — the OWN folder (sandbox-rep7) keeps the apps isolated, but the port is confirmed only because the owner stated it explicitly. Deliverables for THIS task: the project's deploy/ delta files (deploy-config.json and backend-sandbox-rep-7.config.sh) created and validated against the shared engine — NOT an actual deployment. SSH as mostafa with password auth (oth/.cred), rsync --checksum so changed files overwrite by content, verify real exit codes; firewall (if ever needed) only via the control plane to the owner's single current IP. Do not deploy.

## Readiness check
- **REQUIRES:** existing deploy assets; the sibling-project convention; this project's config values; secret-exclude guarantee.

- **MISSING:** nothing. **Ready.**

## What I found (reuse, not recreate)
The deploy engine is shared and generic — I reuse it untouched. Each backend sandbox only adds a tiny **per-project delta** (`deploy/deploy-config.json` + `deploy/<project>.config.sh`). rep-7 is the 7th in that exact lineage (revealer-6978 → rep-2 → rep-4 → rep-6). rep-7's `deploy/` currently holds only `.gitkeep` — the two delta files need creating. All values are dictated verbatim in `index.json`.

## The whole-job checklist, mapped
- **Reuse existing assets** ✓ — shared `deploy.sh`/`deploy_changes.py`/`DEPLOY-PLAYBOOK.md`, nothing new created there.
- **Project-specific config** ✓ — the two delta files below.
- **Local↔VM mapping** ✓ — `…/_external/VolatileWorkSpace/rep7-backend` ↔ `/home/mostafa/sandbox-rep7/backend` (own folder, isolated).
- **Secrets/backups excluded** ✓ — enforced globally by the engine's `DEF_EXCLUDES`; delta adds only `node_modules/dist/logs` plus `.env*`.
- **Migration additive/none** ✓ — `migration:"none"` (no DB migrate on any deploy, per requirement 3).
- **Service/health** — backend-only, internal **port 4200**, no domain/nginx. Build = `rm -rf dist && npm run build`; restart handled by the engine; verify = process listening on 4200 in its own folder.
- **Documented deploy/impact/rollback** ✓ — below.

- **Command (when owner approves a deploy):** `python workspace/shared/infra/deploy_changes.py scan` → then `workspace/shared/infra/deploy.sh` with this project's delta.
- **Impact:** rsync `--checksum` of `rep7-backend` → `/home/mostafa/sandbox-rep7/backend`, `npm run build`, start on :4200. No DB migrate, no domain/nginx, no production touch; 80/443/22 untouched.
